text:
Draw a large spiral onto a piece of paper with 0 and 10 as shown.

In this game you have to place decimals somewhere in a spiral between 0 and 10. Players take it in turns to choose a number from the list below and write it on the spiral.

Watch out! Your number must be larger than the numbers inside it and smaller than the numbers outside it.

1.0, 3.2, 0.6, 1.6, 9.9, 6.7, 5.0, 0.8, 1.2, 7.5, 5.0, 0.1
